title: Belvedere
html_source:
Belvedere College is a private Jesuit secondary school for boys in Dublin, Ireland. It is also known as St. Francis Xavier’s College named after one of the co-founders of the Society of Jesus.

James Joyce was offered a place and attended Belvedere after his family was unable to afford Clongowes.
